_comment: Four voices over 40 NFCorpus test questions, written by a large model rather than sampled from the corpus — the same reasoning persona-lift.ts gives for simulating rather than hand-picking: in production nobody types the corpus's own title back at it. Each voice is a distinct phrasing regime, not a synonym pass: terse is keyword-shaped with no grammar, non_native is simple English with off idiom, why_asker asks the worry underneath the term, outsider avoids the technical vocabulary entirely. Used by rrf-k-scale.ts --personas; every voice of a question is averaged into ONE per-gold number, so paraphrases tighten the estimate without being counted as independent observations.
